scope: Only observed Debian, CPython and local Tesseract/Leptonica native bytes from the reviewed frozen Linux candidate image. SHA-256 plus byte size and complete original notice evidence bind every allowed record; pending and changed bytes remain unauthorized. This review does not claim a complete static source-code closure.
